title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on list price. The data says that's the wrong starting point.

Homes in Palma Ceia, Hyde Park, and Davis Islands that sell for the strongest prices share three measurable traits: they hit the market in true move-in condition, they are priced within two percent of recent comparable sales from the same micro-neighborhood, and they go live on a Thursday or Friday so buyer traffic peaks over the weekend.

Condition outperforms cosmetic staging every time. A Bayshore Boulevard condo that needed zero deferred maintenance sold for four percent over ask last spring. A comparable unit two floors up, priced identically but with visible wear, sat for 40 days and closed below list.

Timing within the month matters too. Listings that go active in the first two weeks of the month consistently accumulate more showings before the first price reduction than those launched in the final ten days.

Photography is not optional. Homes with professionally lit, wide-angle images generate 30 to 40 percent more online clicks in the South Tampa MLS, which translates directly into showing volume.

The market rewards preparation, not just ambition. Seen it hold true block after block.
